title: Calibrated to Whom? Persona and Language Effects on Cultural Values in JEV

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Values Survey Module 2013 (VSM 2013) to matched Saudi and American personas and comparing the differences in the model's Hofstede dimension scores against human national reference data.

Comparing the model's survey responses and confidence scores when prompted in English versus Arabic, utilizing a language cross setup to isolate the effects of the persona framing language from the survey item language.
Measuring stereotyped shifts in Hofstede cultural dimension scores (such as individualism and masculinity) by comparing female and male personas matched on nationality and age.
Measuring stereotyped shifts in Hofstede cultural dimension scores by comparing young and elder personas matched on nationality and gender.
